name: Malabar Mobile Hub
description: Mobile phones, earbuds, smartwatches and accessories shop in Malappuram, Kerala.
hours: Mon–Sat 9:30 AM – 9:00 PM, Sunday 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM
delivery: Free delivery within Malappuram for orders above ₹999. Kerala-wide delivery in 2–4 days (₹60). Cash on delivery available.
returns: 7-day replacement for manufacturing defects. Product must be unused with original box and bill.
payment: UPI, cards, cash on delivery. EMI available on phones above ₹10,000.
warranty: All products carry official brand warranty. Bill provided with every order.
contact: Call or WhatsApp the shop for anything the assistant can't help with.
